title: Key setup shows skill icons
caption: At level 30 the Key setup grid in the Build panel shows each skill's icon with its name under it, and the keys sit under their columns like the game's bar.

title: Key setup on a phone
caption: On a phone at level 30 every cell is the same height and names like Insignia Explosion wrap between words, never mid-word.

title: Shadowstrike gets its icon
caption: At level 4 Shadowstrike on Q shows its icon and no longer splits as Shadowstr / ike; Quick Slice shows its icon on the Left click line.
